fullContent:
Unmada Parpati Rasa 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Unmadrogadhikar 503/30 
 Introduction 
 Unmada parpati rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. It contains ingredients which are helpful in treating mental disorders. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Krishan Dhatura Beej – 5 pieces 
 Ras Parpati – 500 mg 
 
 Description of Ingredients 
 
 Krishan Dhatura Beej (Seed of Datura stramonium ) – This herb has a narcotic effect. It also acts as an appetizer. It improves digestion and also has analgesic effects. It pacifies kapha dosha. 
 Ras Parpati – This is a classical Ayurvedic formulation. This parpati keeps the Vata, pitta and kapha in balanced form. This is prepared using herbal herbal and mineral ingredients. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 First make a fine powder of krishan dhatura beej. 
 Then mix this powder with ras parpati and give frolement to this mixture. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 It is a herbo-mineral Ayurvedic formulation. The ingredients in this are helpful in psychological disorders and have analgesic properties also. They nourish the nerves and strengthen the nervous system. 
 Indications 
 
 OCD 
 Epilepsy 
 Fever 
 Malabsorption 
 
 Dosage 
 1 teaspoon twice a day with plain water. 
 Cautions 
 Take under the medical supervisions. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
